name: Registry Explorer
description: Browse Windows registry hives in a graphical viewer, with bookmarks for known keys and plugins that decode their values.
about: Registry Explorer opens one or more hives at once and presents them as a navigable tree, replaying transaction logs so a hive taken from a running system shows its most recent state. Two things distinguish it from a plain viewer. Bookmarks point straight at keys of known forensic interest, so a hive can be examined without knowing where anything lives. Plugins decode values that are otherwise opaque binary blobs — shellbags, run keys, USB history, application-specific settings — into readable tables. Deleted keys and values recoverable from unallocated space in the hive are surfaced alongside the live ones, and anything on screen can be exported.
